name: ARTIFACT_URL_STABILITY
findings: The verdocumento/ver?t={GUID} webservice and the static taxonomy ZIP (ipp_2019-01-01.zip) are stateless and SHA-256-stable across two fresh out-of-session downloads (E78E3F2F... / 87C44522...).
The GUID is a stable source identifier (candidate for source_filing_key / source_registration_no).

However these do not cover the two real corpus families: ESEF (ListadoIFA -> registro oficial -> consolidated iXBRL) and IPP (listaifi -> nreg -> detalleifialdia -> descargaxbrlipp.ashx). The ESEF consolidated iXBRL path reportedly serves via webservices/verdocumento/ver?e=<opaque-token>, a variant NOT tested here.
limitations: FAIL because ARTIFACT_URL_STABILITY was only proven for one generic GUID artefact (a press/regulatory PDF, not a corpus filing) and one taxonomy ZIP. It was NOT proven for the two target corpus families (ESEF iXBRL and IPP XBRL). The ?e=<token> variant and the ?t={GUID} variant must each be tested out-of-session and across observations before declaring R4 stable. If ?e= changes per visit while still yielding the same bytes, R4 remains FAIL and the canonical identity must not rely on the URL.
